steps: Resuscitate; correct hypokalaemia and hypoglycaemia (cerebral glucose may be low despite normal serum).
Activated charcoal if early; generous IV fluids.
Urinary alkalinisation with IV sodium bicarbonate (target urine pH ~7.5–8) — enhances elimination; keep K replete.
HAEMODIALYSIS for severe toxicity (high levels, acidosis, CNS features, renal failure, pulmonary oedema).
Avoid intubation if possible (loss of compensatory hyperventilation is dangerous); serial levels.

confirm: Tinnitus, hyperventilation, nausea, agitation with a mixed respiratory alkalosis + high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis; rising salicylate level.
